video_title: "We'd Have 1,000 MJs if it was EASY" - Boogie GOES OFF on NBA Parody & Being A Participation Trophy!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins criticizes Vince Goodwill's take on NBA championship parity
quotes.excerpt: Vince Goodwill believes parity is bad for the league and NBA championships are starting to feel like participation trophies.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Vince Goodwill believes parity is bad for the league and NBA championships are starting to feel like participation trophies. Do we agree? Do we disagree? I think that was one of the most outrageous things that you can hear. For me, it showed the strength and where we are in the league. We champion so many different young stars, but the minute all of them start getting a piece of the pie and start challenging each other for championships, now that's considered a bad thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I disagree with the whole statement. It was a pretty crazy statement in the first place. At the end of the day, somebody has to win.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons defends the legacy of non-championship players
quotes.excerpt: I think about guys like Charles Barkley, Allen Iverson, Reggie Miller, Tracy McGrady, Carmelo Anthony, Chris Paul.
quotes.quote: I think about guys like Charles Barkley, Allen Iverson, Reggie Miller, Tracy McGrady, Carmelo Anthony, Chris Paul. The list goes on. You sit here and you make a statement like that. So you mean to tell me the guys that didn't win championships, you're trying to say they're not validated? Even if you win a championship, you're still not validated as what, a good player? And this is coming from a guy that's never put on a uniform in his life, probably never made a team in his life.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the difficulty of competing in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I played in the NBA for nine years. I was hurt a lot. I never got out of the first round.
quotes.quote: I played in the NBA for nine years. I was hurt a lot. I never got out of the first round. You know how hard that was just to make the playoffs and just to compete for 82 games and to get in that seven-game series and go on the road and survive and advance? So the fact that we do have the balance and the depth of talent and good teams year in, year out, that kind of go on eight straight years of a different champion, I think that's great for the league.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons reflects on his departure from Houston
quotes.excerpt: I remember when I left Houston, I went to Dallas and Houston went to the Western Conference Finals.
quotes.quote: I remember when I left Houston, I went to Dallas and Houston went to the Western Conference Finals. You do feel like, damn, they might be better without me type of thing. And the guy that replaced you, you're watching his stats. And so like, you know, it stings a bit.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Mark Jackson's contributions to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: When they won that championship, a lot of former players, including myself, were talking about the contributions that Mark Jackson made.
quotes.quote: When they won that championship, a lot of former players, including myself, were talking about the contributions that Mark Jackson made. So whether he got it on a grand stage or not, people that knew, knew, and we gave him his credit.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons dismisses Max Kellerman's Thunder-Spurs trade scenario
quotes.excerpt: Max Kellerman says if you take Shai Gilgeous-Alexander off the Thunder and you replace him with Jalen Brunson, they beat the Spurs.
quotes.quote: Max Kellerman says if you take Shai Gilgeous-Alexander off the Thunder and you replace him with Jalen Brunson, they beat the Spurs. This is another like hot take that I feel like is clickbaity. I don't even want to get into it because it's going to either be like I'm dissing Jalen Brunson by saying no, or dissing Shai Gilgeous-Alexander by saying yes, but no, it's just not true.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins defends Allen Iverson's legacy against Patrick Beverley's take
quotes.excerpt: Patrick Beverley is saying Jalen Brunson is better than Allen Iverson. I played with AI, and I just don't love this take.
quotes.quote: Patrick Beverley is saying Jalen Brunson is better than Allen Iverson. I played with AI, and I just don't love this take. At some point, we got to start protecting our legends and their legacies. We can't just every time something happens, put their legacies on the chopping block to big up somebody else. It's okay to celebrate Jalen Brunson, it's okay to give him his flowers and his props without bringing anybody else or comparing anybody else.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons names Anthony Edwards as the best American player
quotes.excerpt: If I was going to pick one to start my team, it'd probably be Anthony Edwards.
quotes.quote: If I was going to pick one to start my team, it'd probably be Anthony Edwards. Anthony Edwards is a two-way player, he's athletic, he can score, he defends. I think he does, by the way, Cade Cunningham is up there too, but Anthony Edwards I think is the best all-around American player. Jalen Brunson just won a championship, Finals MVP, that's tough to beat right now, but best player, I think is Anthony Edwards.
